view.note: The fill indicator ≈ is the share of rooms visible on Booking.com that are no longer on sale (closed or restricted sales count too); it is not hotel occupancy. Always shown with a low–high range, and only when Booking.com shows enough (at least half the rooms known for sure); direct bookings, groups and rooms not sold on Booking.com are not visible.
view.suggestionsDescription: Target = reference (competitor median × target position) plus adjustments with numbers, clamped to floor/ceiling. Nothing changes your rates automatically; press “Applied” to record the rate you set.

view.suggestionsEmptyBody: Every night's target is within 2% of your current rate: hold.
view.nightsDescription: Market = median of competitors whose counts Booking.com fully shows. Pace compares with the same weekday 1–8 weeks earlier, at the same days before arrival.
